findings.message: The purification step records generic chromatography. Preserve the specified silica gel and eluent conditions in unmapped_actions because the permitted Purify fields cannot encode them.

value.reason: Purification uses silica gel with Pet. Ether (40‐60):EtOAc (9:1‐7:1). The permitted Purify fields cannot separately encode the stationary phase and eluent conditions.
